who: People who change fonts or colors
takeaways: If you can show it as real text, use real text, not a picture of text.
Real text can be zoomed sharply, recolored, respaced, read aloud and translated. Text baked into an image cannot, and it blurs when enlarged.
Logos and brand names are exempt, because their look is essential. So is any image of text that people can customize, for example font, size and colors.
This is mostly decided in design: hero banners, promo tiles, quote cards and buttons are where text gets flattened into images.
failures: A marketing banner exported as one image, headline included
A testimonial quote shared as a styled graphic
A button made from an image of its label
check: In the file, find every frame where text is part of an image layer or exported asset.
For each, ask whether live text over an image could create the same look.
In the build, zoom to 200% and try selecting the text. If you cannot select it, it is probably an image.

quiz.question: A seasonal campaign banner has a headline in the brand typeface over a photo. Marketing wants to export it as one image. What do you do?
options: Export as one image and put the headline in the alt text
Keep the photo as an image and set the headline as live text using a web font
It is fine, because the headline uses the brand typeface
quiz.why: Alt text helps screen reader users but not people who zoom or change fonts. A brand typeface is not a logo, so live text is required when the technology can show it.

spec: Mark which text is live and which images are background only.
List the web fonts, weights and effects needed so the look can be built in text.
Where a logo or wordmark is used, note it as an image with its alt text.
review: Is this text in an image because it has to be, or because it was quicker?
Can we get this effect with live text, a font and CSS?
What happens to this banner when the copy is translated?
tradeoff: Images give pixel-perfect control and are quicker to produce for campaigns. Live text costs more setup but can be updated, translated and resized without redrawing. Build a banner template with live text once and the cost goes away.
system: Offer banner, promo and quote components with text slots over an image slot, so nobody needs to flatten text to get the look.
pitch: Text in images cannot be zoomed, translated or found by search. Live text works for more people and saves redrawing every time the copy changes.
